cohort: The participants were 120 full-term primiparous women undergoing vaginal delivery who sought epidural analgesia, divided into obese (prepartum BMI >=29 kg/m2) and non-obese (18.5<prepartum BMI<28 kg/m2) groups.
finding: Obese parturients required significantly lower EC50 values for both epidural ropivacaine and sufentanil for effective labor analgesia compared to non-obese parturients.
